findings.message: Section 20's `go-grade-machinery` contract, copied into this ticket, fences `tests/test_harness.py` and embeds it as existing Context (exactly `eval/harness.py`, `squatch/artifacts.py`, `tests/test_harness.py`). That file is not on main. The existing test for the committed harness is `tests/test_eval_harness.py`, and no earlier Phase 6 payload creates `tests/test_harness.py`. When `phase6-continue-06` authors that seed, it would name a missing Context path, which breaks the rule that only existing Context paths are named.
findings.paved_road: fix the plan, then re-author the ticket
